question: What modes of engaging with the text are permitted to a practitioner?
premises: One may recite the text oneself.
One may cause others to recite it.
One may hear it or cause others to hear it.
inference: Reciting, teaching recitation, hearing, and causing others to hear are all valid modes of engagement.
plain_english: One may recite it, have it recited, hear it, or have it heard.
